BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to prohibiting public funding of abortion; addinga new section to chapter 9.02 RCW; and declaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 9.02 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Public funds shall not be used by state or local governments, orany political subdivision or agency thereof, to pay or otherwisereimburse, either directly or indirectly, any person, agency,organization, or facility for the performance of any induced abortion.Public funds may be used to pay for the performance of an inducedabortion necessary to prevent the death of either the pregnant woman orher unborn child under circumstances where every reasonable effort ismade to preserve the life of each.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, morals, or safety, or supportof the state government and its existing public institutions, and takes p. 1 SB 5852effect immediately.
